lines.text: Red Dead Redemption 2, a western with parachutes in its files?
A dataminer found parachute references inside the PC version, and GamesRadar reported it.
The names include skydive at parachute pack, and chute off bag.
Cowboys never skydive, so fans guessed those files belong to GTA 6.
GTA 5 already has parachutes, but those names are not in its own files.
Other outlets say it's simpler: Rockstar ran several projects, and leftovers slipped in.
Rockstar has never confirmed any of it, so treat this as a fan theory.
Still, skydiving over Leonida would be wild.
